# Yellowpages.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/yellowpages-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/yellowpages-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Yellowpages.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape YellowPages.com in 2025](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-yellowpages)
- **Code:** [`yellowpages.py`](yellowpages.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Business pages](results/business_pages.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Yellowpages business pages
- Yellowpages search pages

## Functions

- `scrape_search(query, location=None, max_pages=None)`: scrape yellowpages.com for listings
- `scrape_pages(urls)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape yellowpages business pages

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import yellowpages


async def main():
    search = await yellowpages.scrape_search(
        query="chinese restaurants",
        location="San Francisco, CA",
        max_pages=3,
    )


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields of the sample output (top-level keys of the first item):

- [`results/business_pages.json`](results/business_pages.json): `name`, `categories`, `rating`, `ratingCount`, `phone`, `website`, `address`, `workingHours`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `@type`, `@context`, `name`, `url`, `address`, `aggregateRating`, `telephone`, `openingHours`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`yellowpages.py`](yellowpages.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `asp` = `True`: Anti Scraping Protection, the earlier name of the [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker)
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy
- `proxy_pool` = `"public_residential_pool"`: proxy pool (datacenter or residential)

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/yellowpages-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_page_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
